amount_notes: Amount not publicly stated. Assessed case by case.
organization_types_eligible: Organizations operating in countries where Scotiabank does business
Organizations with a sustained record of achievement
eligibility_criteria: Must be a registered charity or non-profit organization
Must operate in a country where Scotiabank does business
Must have a sustained record of achievement with measurable impact
Programs must align with ScotiaRISE focus areas: education, newcomer support, or employment
exclusions: CRITICAL: Sports teams explicitly excluded unless funding is pursuant to a Scotiabank local support program
Religious organizations unless program is open to all regardless of faith
notes: ELIGIBILITY RISK: Sports teams explicitly excluded per official guidelines. Emerge Academy as a hockey academy may be classified as a sports team. Do not include in Tier 1 or 2 without confirming applicant is applying as an education/employment NFP not as a sports team. Apply via https://forms.benevity.org/5c489b18-f9e5-4d28-a615-023850c25354
